mainEntity.name: Is AEO more important for general dentistry or specialty practices?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is beneficial for both general dentistry and specialty practices, though the focus might shift. General dentistry practices can use AEO to capture a broad range of informational queries and local 'dentist near me' searches. Specialty practices, such as orthodontics or periodontics, can leverage AEO to answer highly specific questions related to their specialized services, positioning themselves as experts in niche areas. For instance, an orthodontist can optimize for 'How long do braces take?' or 'Benefits of Invisalign.' Both types of practices gain visibility and authority by providing direct answers to patient questions.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO is important for both general and specialty dental practices. General dentists benefit from broad informational and local searches, while specialists can target niche questions related to their expertise.
